scope: Public hosted Ferro launch with evidence-backed AMSL component adoption
default_worker: bounded implementation on a lower-reasoning coding model after contracts are frozen

tasks.title: Reconcile launch baseline and active work
steps: Fetch main; record reviewed merge and dirty worktrees without changing them.
Inventory live agents/cwd and read relevant ajent.social; record conflicts and branch owners.
Establish local-mode baseline commands and capture actual results under build lease.
acceptance: Exact base SHA, worktree list and regression commands recorded; no stale branch wholesale merge.
tasks.verification: git diff --check; local Go/Node suites on selected baseline; report Chrome skips explicitly

tasks.title: Complete cross-machine semantic census
steps: Use restricted census to revisit mini and MacBook source paths; record current revisions and uncommitted differences.
Compare at least two independent source lifecycles per candidate or justify RFC path C; inspect actual negative-path tests.
Mark each boundary EXTRACT, REFERENCE_EXISTING, INVESTIGATE or REJECT; separate source lineage and third-party forks.
acceptance: No component justified by filename or worktree count; source maturity and differences documented; password/session divergence retained.
tasks.verification: Reviewed comparison matrix and cited source locations in private evidence; no source runtime test claims without execution

tasks.title: Clear provenance and public evidence boundary
steps: Inspect license/history/authorship for proposed copied code; flag restricted upstream license.
Create sanitized behavior contracts and attribution plan; forbid unapproved copying.
Review public fixtures, paths, URLs and notices before package work.
acceptance: Every extraction has explicit original-code or cleared-copy path; restricted census never enters public commits.
tasks.verification: Provenance review plus secret/private-identifier scan of proposed public artifacts

tasks.title: Qualify generated hosted application profile and neutral contract
steps: Identify the versioned, public, neutral contract required to consume the generated application profile; keep private project names and source out of public artifacts.
Qualify an AMOS-generated paid application and its authoritative provider/admission adapter, tenant isolation, restart/recovery, and operational ownership against the consumer journey.

Compare the qualified profile with preserved preserved hosted runtime services and current Ferro behavior; record exact residual Ferro-owned browser/device responsibilities and migration constraints without inventing login or migration work.
acceptance: Versioned public neutral contract is reviewable and provenance-safe; generated paid app/provider/tenant isolation/recovery evidence is recorded against exact revisions and limitations.
preserved hosted runtime preservation is explicit; no new hosted runtime adoption task is eligible until D08 is accepted and D04/D05 freeze the consumer contract.
Browser action authority remains based on explicit pairing, exact-origin policy, per-task interaction consent and action confirmation; authentication or paid admission alone cannot grant it.
tasks.verification: Independent contract review plus cited generated-app/provider/tenant-isolation/recovery qualification evidence; no runtime result may be inferred from documentation alone

tasks.title: Freeze hosted architecture and threat model
steps: Adopt or explicitly revise the qualified generated application/provider profile with rationale; do not invent app-owned hosted login, billing or schema migration.
Model tenant/device/task authority, stale worker/extension fencing, provider boundaries and destructive-action confirmation.
Define local-mode preservation and rollback boundaries; reject unsupported browser actions.
acceptance: No unresolved authority or replay semantics; coordinator approves the versioned application/provider adapter, tenant boundary, single device/task scope and deployment profile.
tasks.verification: Threat-model walkthrough using readiness Gate 3 scenarios

tasks.title: Freeze executable contracts and dependency versions
steps: Freeze the versioned neutral profile contract and only the consumer routes/operation schemas required for Ferro browser/device integration, with success/error examples and authority matrix.
Assign hosted identity, paid-admission, persistence and migration ownership to the qualified application/provider profile; specify only residual Ferro-owned state and compatibility adapters.
Pin reviewed dependencies only after D08 qualification; define bounded browser/device payloads and compatible protocol versions.
Freeze the maintenance CLI/workflow contract and IAM role separately; it has no public endpoint or arbitrary SQL capability.
acceptance: Contracts validate; examples cover denied cases; no implementation agent must invent a shared interface; lockfile owner assigned.
No app-owned hosted login, paid entitlement source or migration is specified unless D08 evidence proves a narrow residual requirement and D04 records its owner.
tasks.verification: OpenAPI/JSON Schema validation; contract fixture round trips; interface compile checks

tasks.title: Freeze website and extension interaction states
steps: Enumerate logged-out/linking/online/offline/unpaid/busy/uncertain/revoked/deleted states.
Define screen copy, selectors, focus/live announcements, fixture API responses and exact confirmation UI.
Preserve glass bubbles and frame-color behavior; define account-separated local history.
acceptance: Every error has recovery action; UI fixtures match D05 before integration; no silent tab switch or credential copy onboarding.
tasks.verification: Review static UI fixtures against architecture and accessibility checklist

tasks.title: Record launch-owner decisions and external setup
steps: Prepare concrete deployment-profile cost/resource assumptions and required secret-reference names after D08.
Record the qualified application/provider profile's customer identity, paid-access, support and retention ownership; separately record Ferro browser/device and deployment responsibilities.
Separate prepared artifacts from authorized actual mutations; use fake values in committed examples.
Obtain or prepare an authorized draft store item for its stable ID early; public publication waits for R02.
acceptance: No secret values committed; all public commercial claims and deployment inputs have an accountable owner; no implicit activation of other product staging.
tasks.verification: Owner-reviewed decision table and non-secret config schema validation

tasks.title: Implement PostgreSQL servicecred Store
steps: Reuse existing servicecred public API; add parameterized SQL Store adapter and caller-applied schema.
Implement atomic create, exact-bound revoke, authoritative lookup and sanitized list with context/timeouts.
Keep boltstore behavior/API and avoid cached authentication.
acceptance: Two processes see committed revocation; no overwrite or secret leak; DB failures deny.
tasks.verification: go test -race ./servicecred/... using disposable PostgreSQL contract suite

tasks.title: Verify credential store parity and publishable evidence
steps: Exercise all existing denied grant/expiry/scope/redaction cases against both supported stores.
Add DB outage, revoke/create race, account/resource mismatch and fresh-process checks.
Produce candidate implementation commit and review bundle without claiming stable status.
acceptance: Every Store guarantee has a real persistence test; SQL driver/dependency rationale and provenance included.
tasks.verification: go test -race ./servicecred/...; redaction serialization tests; package review

tasks.title: Dogfood credentials in hosted Ferro
steps: Pin reviewed published AMSL commit without replace/GOWORK override.
Wire trusted account/device ceilings and request-time verification into hosted middleware.
Exercise two credentials/users and restart revocation through real HTTP handlers.
acceptance: Foreign device/session/task denied; disabled account overrides token; local shared mode never authorizes hosted endpoints.
tasks.verification: go test ./internal/hosted/auth -run TestDeviceCredential -count=1 with PostgreSQL

tasks.title: Freeze checkout capability contract
steps: Write exact common lifecycle from D02, SDK alternatives and non-goals.
Specify durable attempt/lease/payload hash and provider-retention recovery semantics.
Record restricted evidence honestly; obtain API/security review before implementation.
acceptance: No permanent exactly-once claim; caller retains prices/redirects/access; unknown outcome has explicit recover/needs-review state.
tasks.verification: Catalog schema validation and deterministic generation; adversarial contract review

tasks.title: Implement customer and checkout coordination
steps: Implement frozen attempt lifecycle and PostgreSQL storage using maintained Stripe SDK adapter.
Claim provider work transactionally, call provider outside DB transaction and fence commit.
Add recovery and bounded retry/backoff without creating a new attempt after ambiguous timeout.
acceptance: Same attempt stable; changed payload conflicts; concurrent processes do not silently create independent customer operations; expired idempotency outcomes require reconciliation.
tasks.verification: go test -race ./billing/checkout/... with real PostgreSQL and deterministic lost-response provider fixtures

tasks.title: Dogfood checkout and portal routes
steps: Consume immutable AMSL pin; derive customer/price/return URLs from trusted server/account state.
Wire real web checkout/portal/status APIs and already-subscribed recovery.
Verify test-mode session create and redirect without granting entitlement.
acceptance: Cross-account/price/return spoofing rejected; duplicate clicks reuse one active attempt; portal belongs to signed-in customer.
tasks.verification: go test ./internal/hosted/billing -run TestCheckout; Stripe test-mode flow recorded; exercise actual durable web sessions and CSRF middleware, including unauthenticated, missing/invalid CSRF and cross-account denial

tasks.title: Freeze subscription reconciliation contract
steps: Specify verified inbox identity, customer mapping, lease epoch, current provider projection and transaction boundaries.
Specify duplicate/out-of-order/unmatched event recovery and sweeps; avoid timestamp-only ordering.
Keep entitlement/grace/tier predicates outside package.
acceptance: Unknown customer events remain retryable; stale workers cannot overwrite current projection; provider mode/account is part of event binding.
tasks.verification: Catalog validation and failure-state design review

tasks.title: Implement verified inbox and reconciliation
steps: Implement durable accept/claim/reconcile/project/sweep API and official Stripe adapter.
Verify raw payload using SDK in ingress adapter; atomic inbox commit before acknowledgment.
Add bounded retry, dead-letter metadata, lease fencing and missing-webhook repair.
acceptance: Crash/replay/reorder/race tests converge to current provider state; wrong account/mode/signature cannot affect projection.
tasks.verification: go test -race ./billing/subscription/... with PostgreSQL and provider fixtures

tasks.title: Dogfood subscription projection in Ferro
steps: Wire signed webhook route, durable reconciliation worker and scheduled sweep.
Consume immutable module pin and map customer identity only from trusted binding.
Expose billing status/freshness for website and task admission.
acceptance: Real Stripe test-mode duplicate/reordered/cancel/payment-failure flows update correct account; redirect is never payment evidence.
tasks.verification: go test ./internal/hosted/billing -run TestReconcile; provider test-mode evidence

tasks.title: Document existing-library identity adoption
steps: Record why source JWT/passkey/password flows are not one reusable contract.
Reference OIDC verification and SCS/PostgreSQL integration, including expiry/revoke/CSRF tests Ferro must run.
Keep password hashing reference-only for this passwordless launch.
acceptance: No new universal auth/user package or invented crypto; catalog distinguishes library reference from implemented AMSL behavior.
tasks.verification: Catalog validation and recipe review against F03/F04 test requirements

tasks.title: Implement reusable credential-free Go validation
steps: Use workflow_call with bounded typed inputs; pin action/tool SHAs and minimal permissions.
Run fmt/vet/test/race without arbitrary shell hooks, secret inheritance or privileged fork execution.
Preserve callers' trigger/concurrency ownership and stable aggregate result contract.
acceptance: Malformed module path/timeouts rejected; a failing test makes caller fail; no elevated token or long-lived secret.
tasks.verification: actionlint plus workflow fixture/static checks; actual caller runs are A12

tasks.title: Dogfood Go validation in two real modules
steps: Pin immutable reusable workflow in Ferro and AMSL Go; preserve product-specific Chrome/Postgres/security checks.
Record real successful runs in both repos and an intentionally failing test on a disposable branch.
Verify required-check names and merge_group behavior, then remove deliberate failure.
Coordinate the two caller lockfiles/check-name edits explicitly; preserve each repository own non-Go gates.
acceptance: Two real module invocations demonstrated; baseline gates not weakened; no synthetic-only reuse claim.
tasks.verification: GitHub Actions run URLs and exact caller/callee SHAs; check-required-status verification

tasks.title: Implement AWS deployment identity component
steps: Use existing or explicitly new GitHub OIDC provider; generate exact audience/subject trust from frozen contract.
Separate artifact/deploy roles and bounded resource policies; limit PassRole.
Return safe identity outputs and import instructions.
acceptance: Wrong repo/ref/environment denied by trust shape; no blanket admin or duplicate shared provider creation.
tasks.verification: Pulumi unit/mocks + JSON policy assertions

tasks.title: Add deployment-identity enforcement tests
steps: Test raw-role bypasses, wildcard trust, wrong audience, unsafe role delegation and environment mismatch.
Define policy attachment and audit outputs separately from construction.
Prepare disposable live federation fixture, no auto-apply.
acceptance: Policy rejects unsafe raw and component resources; exact allowed contexts pass; live evidence still explicitly pending.
tasks.verification: Pulumi policy tests and synthetic trust fixtures

tasks.title: Dogfood deployment identity in Ferro CI
steps: Consume immutable Pulumi component and wire environment-specific GitHub deploy role.
Verify authorized qualification federation and denied wrong-context federation.
Record actual branch/environment protection and least-privilege resource access.
acceptance: No stored cloud access key; untrusted PR never receives deployment credentials; pipeline role cannot edit unrelated resources.
tasks.verification: Disposable AWS federation checks and CI run evidence

tasks.title: Implement private AWS PostgreSQL component
steps: Implement approved private network/SG/encryption/secret/backup/deletion inputs with explicit cost and availability settings.
Export TLS/secret-reference/network outputs; support existing-resource import.
Keep runtime DDL permission separate from migration role.
acceptance: No public DB, unrestricted ingress or secret output; backup/deletion choices visible; parameter/version pin is explicit.
tasks.verification: Pulumi mock/resource-property tests

tasks.title: Add database policy and failure tests
steps: Reject public/unencrypted/unbacked-up/raw bypass resources and plaintext outputs.
Test allowed explicit availability/deletion profiles and import behavior.
Prepare restore fixture that consumes exported outputs.
acceptance: Mocks and enforcement tests are labeled separately; production enforcement not inferred from policy-file existence.
tasks.verification: Pulumi policy suite + resource output secret checks

tasks.title: Wire database component into Ferro infrastructure
steps: Consume the immutable database component and wire its outputs into Ferro connection, TLS, secret and migration-role configuration.
Verify the composition with Pulumi mocks/policies and a reviewed preview; hand the outputs to I03 for deployment.

This task completes wiring only; AMSL adoption and restore evidence remain incomplete until A18.
tasks.verification: Pulumi composition mock/policy checks and reviewed resource preview; no live adoption claim

tasks.title: Dogfood database through Ferro deployment and restore
steps: Verify the deployed Ferro consumes the immutable database component outputs for connection/TLS/secret config; use the I03 deployment path, not ad hoc provisioning.
Test denied public connection, app least privilege and migration role separation.
Restore a disposable copy and prove deletion/revocation tombstones survive before traffic.
acceptance: Real consumer TLS and restore meet readiness targets; raw app credentials never printed; infrastructure policy attachment verified.
tasks.verification: Disposable cloud DB checks and timed restore evidence

tasks.title: Scaffold hosted composition without changing local mode
steps: Create hosted command, validated config, route composition seams and graceful shutdown.
Add liveness/readiness and injectable stores/provider transports.
Leave local Owner/Unix election/token behavior local.
acceptance: Cloud command never launches Chrome or uses local shared bearer; missing required production config fails startup.
tasks.verification: go test ./internal/hosted/config ./internal/hosted/server ./cmd/ferro-cloud; local regression suite

tasks.title: Implement Ferro-owned browser/task persistence
steps: Implement only D05-assigned Ferro-owned browser/task/device state and persistence boundaries.
Consume tenant identity and provider/admission context from the qualified profile; do not duplicate profile-owned account, login, billing or migration state.
Provide disposable fixtures and recovery/compatibility evidence for Ferro-owned state.
acceptance: Tenant-scoped task/device guarantees are tested; no global unscoped child lookup; no duplicate profile-owned tenant state or application migration.
tasks.verification: Tenant-scoped task/device persistence tests with the qualified store contract and recovery fixtures; no application-schema migration claim

tasks.title: Integrate qualified application authentication context
steps: Consume the D08/D05 versioned authentication context from the generated application profile through its supported adapter.
Keep customer identity creation, login callbacks, sessions and account lifecycle in the authoritative application profile; do not add a Ferro-owned login or credential store.
Bind each browser task to the authenticated tenant/device context and reject missing, stale or cross-tenant context.
acceptance: Only the qualified profile can establish customer identity; stale, missing and cross-tenant contexts are denied without granting browser action authority.
tasks.verification: Consumer adapter contract checks plus actual qualified-profile context journey recorded later at Q01

tasks.title: Consume qualified application session lifecycle
steps: Integrate the qualified profile's session and request-integrity boundary through the versioned contract; do not create Ferro-owned web sessions.
Honor logout, revoke, expiry, disabled/deleted tenant and recent-auth results from the authoritative profile.
Keep web/account operations distinct from device/browser-operation authority.
acceptance: Profile session revocation/expiry and request-integrity denials propagate to Ferro; no web credential by itself authorizes browser mutation.
tasks.verification: Consumer adapter checks for profile session expiry/revocation and request-integrity outcomes; no app-owned session-store claim

tasks.title: Implement extension device linking and revocation
steps: Implement frozen first-party code/PKCE exchange, exact extension redirect allowlist and atomic consumption.
Issue scoped device credential once; bind Chrome session nonce and account/device metadata.
Wire device revoke/list and lost-exchange relink behavior.
acceptance: Wrong verifier/extension/account, reused/expired code fail; link response never logs secret; old device cannot reply after revoke.
tasks.verification: go test ./internal/hosted/devices -run TestLink; two-process consume/revoke cases

tasks.title: Implement fenced pairing and command transport
steps: Implement explicit pair generation and account/device checks on next/reply; one active poll with bounded heartbeat.
Persist dispatch before send; validate command/task/worker epoch/origin/deadline on reply.
Handle duplicate/late/conflicting replies and response-loss uncertainty without redelivery.
acceptance: No foreign/stale command delivery; pair change cannot interrupt dispatched action unnoticed; two replicas share authoritative state.
tasks.verification: go test -race ./internal/hosted/browser/... ./internal/hosted/commands/... against PostgreSQL fault fixtures

tasks.title: Implement durable task admission and worker lifecycle
steps: Implement frozen task transitions, idempotent create/fingerprint, worker lease/epoch and bounded event log.
Add durable cancel/deadlines and actor-bound status/events.
Make worker loss before dispatch recoverable and after dispatch uncertain.
acceptance: Concurrent duplicate creates produce one task; conflicting intents 409; stale worker cannot append/dispatch; cancel idempotent and cross-user denied.
tasks.verification: go test -race ./internal/hosted/tasks/... ./internal/hosted/events/... using two-process crash fixtures

tasks.title: Adapt existing executor to hosted task and policy
steps: Implement PageDriver over durable command bridge and per-task isolated runner/snapshot context.
Preserve fresh target signatures, read-only gate, origin checks, bounded planner passes and uncertainty.
Wire human action confirmation; unsupported/ambiguous sensitive actions pause or refuse.
acceptance: Never share model/page/snapshot state across accounts; malicious page/model output cannot widen authority; local executor regression remains green.
tasks.verification: go test ./internal/hosted/execution/... ./internal/hosted/driver/...; actual Chrome fixture command flow Q01

tasks.title: Implement encrypted OpenRouter key lifecycle
steps: Use maintained envelope/KMS implementation and account/provider/version context.
Implement key presence, test, replace/delete and cache invalidation without returning raw key.
Bound use to configured OpenRouter endpoint and role-scoped KMS access.
acceptance: Ciphertext swap across accounts fails; KMS/DB failure denies; logs/errors/exports contain no key; deleted/replaced key never reused.
tasks.verification: go test ./internal/hosted/modelkeys/... including KMS-adapter contract and redaction fixtures

tasks.title: Wire bounded model client and provider errors
steps: Resolve fixed OpenRouter base/model allowlist and decrypt only for authorized task.
Set timeout/token/cost ceilings, cancel propagation and redirect restrictions; reuse existing planner schema.
Map provider 401/429/5xx/timeouts to safe UI codes; redact page/model diagnostics.
acceptance: No arbitrary outbound URL or key forwarded to another host; no idle model calls or automatic new task retry.

tasks.title: Honor authoritative paid admission at task boundary
steps: Consume the generated application's versioned paid-admission result; do not reconstruct subscription policy from checkout redirects or AMSL package state.
Bind admission to tenant, device, task limits and expiry; keep browser origin and action grants in Ferro's separate policy checks.
Define behavior for expired/revoked admission and already-admitted work from the qualified contract.
acceptance: Missing, stale, denied or cross-tenant paid admission fails closed; paid status never grants origin access or browser-action authority.
tasks.verification: Admission adapter cases for qualified allow/deny/stale/tenant outcomes; provider lifecycle evidence remains owned by the profile qualification

tasks.title: Add account quotas and abuse backpressure
steps: Implement transactionally reserved one-active-task/account and frozen per-account/global rate limits.
Bound queues/payloads/task steps and release reservations on terminal states/crash.
Return stable 429/Retry-After and enforce anonymous link/auth rate controls.
acceptance: Two replicas cannot exceed account concurrency through races; disconnected/canceled tasks release reservations; memory/DB growth bounded.
tasks.verification: go test -race ./internal/hosted/limits/... with shared-DB parallel admission

tasks.title: Integrate application-owned export and deletion lifecycle
steps: Use the qualified application's export/deletion lifecycle and recent-auth result; Ferro may export only its own browser/task data under the contract.
Propagate account disable, device revoke, task stop and provider deletion-pending outcomes without implementing a second billing cancellation ledger.
Apply deletion/revocation outcomes to Ferro-owned transient data and recovery state as D05 specifies.
acceptance: Cross-tenant export is denied; disabled/deleted tenants cannot run or relink; provider deletion-pending state remains visible; recovery cannot resurrect revoked access.
tasks.verification: go test ./internal/hosted/account/... ./internal/hosted/retention/... with provider/DB failure injection

tasks.title: Instrument redacted health and operational events
steps: Add structured allowlisted logs, request/task IDs and metrics for task state, reply uncertainty, reconcile backlog and auth failures.
Redact page text, prompt, key, URL query, headers and account email.
Bound labels/cardinality and document health checks and secret-free diagnostics.
acceptance: Canary secrets and page content never appear in logs/traces/errors; metrics do not create unbounded account labels.
tasks.verification: go test ./internal/hosted/telemetry/... with log/trace canary scan

tasks.title: Implement audited operator controls and kill switches
steps: Implement narrowly scoped account-disable/device-revoke and global stop-admission/mutation controls using existing lifecycle services; no public admin HTTP endpoint.
Run commands through a protected maintenance workflow/task role with verified operator/deployment identity and append-only redacted audit event; no unaudited direct database edits.
Require explicit account/task targets and dry-run preview; exclude transcript export, provider-key retrieval, arbitrary SQL or impersonation.
acceptance: Unprivileged runtime cannot invoke maintenance controls; targeted account revoke cancels its tasks and leaves others running.
Every maintenance mutation records actor/action/resource/result; kill switches stop new dispatch without deleting customer data.
tasks.verification: go test ./internal/hosted/admin/... ./cmd/ferro-cloud-admin; protected workflow denied-path and qualification kill-switch drill

tasks.title: Separate local and hosted extension transports
steps: Define explicit mode/endpoint config with production HTTPS fixed allowlist and dev config separate.
Implement hosted poll/reply/status transport with auth, timeouts, version header and backoff.
Preserve local mode compatibility via adapter fixtures.
acceptance: No arbitrary hosted base or credential fallback; local tests pass; one bounded poll/no idle task calls.
tasks.verification: node --test extension/transport.test.cjs

tasks.title: Implement extension sign-in and credential storage
steps: Use identity web flow with stable callback, random state and PKCE; exchange only approved endpoint.
Store device secret in trusted extension storage, isolate from page messages and clear on logout/revoke/expiry.
Expose linking/offline/relink UI states without copying tokens.
acceptance: Wrong state/redirect/code denied; browser restart restores only allowed state; secrets never appear in content-script messages.

tasks.title: Implement explicit hosted pairing lifecycle
steps: Bind selected tab+session nonce+server generation; distinguish active Chrome tab from paired tab.
Handle navigation/close/discard/update/offline and refuse switch until stop/uncertainty resolved.
Show paired site consistently across side-panel tab navigation.
acceptance: Switching tabs never silently changes authority; same numeric tab after restart cannot adopt old command/snapshot.
tasks.verification: node --test extension/pairing.test.cjs; browser navigation/generation fixtures

tasks.title: Implement typed dispatch validation and dedup journal
steps: Validate packaged operation schema, origin/generation/deadline/target/confirmation before content dispatch.
Journal command in session storage before action; reject duplicate/conflicting command and stale worker epoch.
Package all executable code; no eval, remote script or arbitrary CDP pass-through.
acceptance: Duplicate or lost replies never reexecute a mutation; worker restart stops with uncertainty; forged content messages cannot execute.
tasks.verification: node --test extension/hosted-dispatch.test.cjs; actual Chrome crash/replay fixtures Q02

tasks.title: Minimize permissions and page data capture
steps: Implement optional explicit-origin grants and injection on approved paired pages; deny off-origin redirects before DOM capture.
Exclude password/OTP/payment fields and minimize snapshot content.
Validate frame/popup/file/canvas limitations and accurate error text.
acceptance: Revoked host permission stops read/action; no background all-tabs scrape; local and hosted snapshot parity preserved.

tasks.title: Wire trusted confirmation and cancellation UI
steps: Render bounded task start consent and action-specific confirmation digest state.
Send confirmations only from trusted UI gestures; never from content/model messages.
Show cancel requested vs canceled vs uncertain; require inspect before retry.
acceptance: Page cannot approve itself; old target/generation/expired confirmation rejected; double clicks not duplicate actions.

tasks.title: Wire hosted side-panel states and account history
steps: Integrate auth/pair/model/paid/online states and server event cursors.
Retain floating glass design, keyboard/focus/reduced motion and bounded local archive partitioned by account.
Handle refresh/restart without resubmitting a task; show site/model/permission disclosure.
As sole extension composition owner, wire the packaged auth/transport/pairing/dispatch/control modules into background.js and the existing local flow; modules that are never called are unfinished.
acceptance: No previous-account transcript leak; every error/revoke/payment/offline path has accurate actionable state.
Untrusted model/page/history rendering cannot execute HTML/JS or load remote tracking images; URLs are scheme-validated.

steps: Set stable publisher ID/version and minimal justified permissions; bundle all dependencies locally.
Generate clean ZIP from allowlisted files with hash and source SHA; exclude tests/dev URLs/secrets.
Prepare real screenshots/reviewer instructions and protocol compatibility table.

steps: Inject response loss/crashes at dispatch/reply/commit and extension worker/browser restart.

tasks.verification: Deterministic two-replica+Chrome fault suite and executed failure matrix

tasks.title: Verify full paid lifecycle and reconciliation
steps: Run Stripe test-mode checkout, duplicate/out-of-order/missing events, renewal failure, cancel, portal and deletion.
Verify two-instance checkout race and unknown result recovery; actual task admission follows committed projection.
Prepare separately approved bounded live payment/cancel/refund test for release owner.
acceptance: Gate 2 test-mode evidence complete; live-payment evidence not claimed until observed; active/canceled/past_due behavior matches public policy.
tasks.verification: Stripe CLI/test clocks where supported; API/UI task-admission integration suite

tasks.title: Verify retention, restore and key rotation
steps: Restore isolated backup with KMS references and reapply deletion/revocation tombstones before traffic.
Measure RPO/RTO and verify TLS/runtime permission boundaries.
Rotate app/provider encryption secrets and reconcile canceled accounts without resurrection.
acceptance: Recovery targets measured; no deleted/revoked account regains access; restore resources removed via IaC.
tasks.verification: Timed restore and key-rotation drills with sanitized evidence

tasks.title: Measure load, idle resource use and soak
steps: Run declared 100-device/25-task load, bounded global saturation and one-replica loss.
Measure idle extension vs baseline for 30min; run 24h bounded soak.
Record API/cancel latency, DB pools/queue bounds, uncertainty, cost and actual alerts.
acceptance: Targets met or formally revised before release; no leak/unbounded growth; no invented performance comparison.
tasks.verification: Versioned load/soak scripts; actual metrics/cost results; alert-delivery evidence

tasks.title: Verify supported browsers and accessibility
steps: Test fresh/upgrade/store-ID callbacks on macOS and Windows Chrome plus minimum fixture version.
Exercise keyboard, focus, screen reader status, contrast, reduced motion, zoom and narrow side panel.
Check restricted pages, closed/discarded tab, multiple windows, browser restart and unsupported capability messages.
acceptance: Supported matrix documented honestly; no runtime authority switches with active tab; local mode still usable.
tasks.verification: Browser matrix and accessibility checklist with versioned screenshots/results

tasks.title: Complete independent security and supply-chain review
steps: Independently review auth/linking/IDOR/CSRF/XSS/SSRF/prompt injection/payment/keys/fencing/IAM with denied-path tests.
Review package provenance, dependency/container scans, SBOM and public AMSL evidence.
Fix blocking findings and rerun affected consumer suites; record explicit accepted low risk only.
acceptance: No open critical/high or medium affecting authority/data/payments/duplicate effects; exact candidate hashes reviewed.
tasks.verification: Independent review report, exploit/regression tests and scan triage

tasks.title: Close AMSL adoption evidence and catalog
steps: Update each intended capability with actual implementation/version/tests and consumer verification limits.
Record extraction/adoption effort, removed duplication, regressions and second-consumer evidence.
Run schema/catalog checks and seek explicit maintainer lifecycle decision; no automatic stable promotion.
acceptance: Every claimed component has real Ferro consumption; references are not mislabeled packages; public records sanitized.
tasks.verification: python3 tools/catalog.py validation/generation using repository-documented commands; evidence review

tasks.title: Complete support, policy and release rehearsal
steps: Rehearse account/device revoke, billing correction, uncertain action, outage and deletion support.
Verify alert recipient delivery, scoped admin access, audit records and stop-admission/mutation switches.
Get owner signoff on commercial/retention/support content and prepared live qualification.
acceptance: Operator can execute runbooks; no broad transcript/key access; critical alerts actually arrive.
tasks.verification: Observed tabletop/safe-failure drill and owner signoff

tasks.title: Submit and qualify public Chrome Web Store build
steps: Prepare exact ZIP/hash, listing assets, privacy/permission explanations and reviewer account/steps.
Submit through authorized publisher; track requested changes without mutating approved build silently.
Verify published store installation, sign-in callback and upgrade compatibility.
acceptance: Submission != approval; public availability and exact artifact verified; runtime code policy and disclosures match behavior.
tasks.verification: Store submission/approval IDs and actual published-install smoke test

tasks.title: Deploy immutable candidate and verify public paid journey
steps: Deploy reviewed digest/config through authorized protected pipeline; no DNS/secret console drift.
Run full public new-customer and bounded authorized live-payment lifecycle through published extension.
Verify rollback/kill switches/metrics/support and retain exact artifact manifest.
acceptance: All applicable readiness gates have observed evidence; real charge/cancel semantics verified when authorized; no unresolved launch blockers.
Deployed image and public extension match the artifacts independently reviewed in Q07; a material change restarts affected review/store gates.
Production Google consent accepts intended public users; test-only OAuth allowlists and development extension IDs are absent.
tasks.verification: Public-domain smoke and paid-journey evidence; exact source/image/extension hashes

tasks.title: Record public-launch readiness decision and handoff
steps: Audit every task and gate, resolved findings, adoption evidence and external approvals.
Write current installation/account/billing/support docs and explicit supported scope.
Hand operations owner the tested runbooks and schedule post-launch review.
acceptance: No planned/skipped critical work presented as complete; public status and AMSL maturity distinguished.
tasks.verification: Final evidence audit, link checks, plan graph validation and release-owner decision
